'''Ward of Arceuus''' is a spell within the [[Arceuus spellbook]] that requires level 73 [[Magic]] and the completion of [[A Kingdom Divided]] to be cast.

When the player is under the effects of the Ward of Arceuus spell, they will gain various buffs for a certain amount of time (<math>0.6 * Y</math> seconds), where <math>Y</math> is the player's Magic level at the time of casting.
* Players are immune to [[Corruption (status)|corruption]].
* If successfully bound by [[grasp spells]], players will only be bound in place for 0.6 seconds.
* [[Demon (attribute)|Demonic]] creatures will have their damage reduced by 10%.
* Demonic creatures will have their prayer drain effects reduced by 33%; this stacks multiplicatively with the [[spectral spirit shield]].

When the damage reduction is calculated, bear in mind that 10% of the incoming damage is first rounded down before being subtracted from the original damage value, meaning no benefit is provided by this spell when hit for less than 10 damage.{{CiteTwitter|author=Mod Ash|url=https://twitter.com/JagexAsh/status/1402928439422763014|date=10 June 2021|archiveurl=https://reldo.runescape.wiki/i/96972|archivedate=21 May 2023|quote=If I'm reading my colleagues' code correctly, it calculates 10% of the damage, rounding down, then subtracts the result from the original damage. So the *reduction* rounds down.}}
